notes: Pet type becomes clickable divs with no tabindex or role: not reachable by Tab, so the booking cannot be created by keyboard. Considered and rejected: axe-states (plain divs with click handlers violate no axe rule; if Kennel adds ARIA roles without required children, axe would flag aria-required-children and this golden needs revisiting), focus-visible (divs are not in the tab order), dead-control (clicking a div changes the DOM selection state), mouse-driven checks (options are still clickable).
